newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack up after maintenance units news.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack up after maintenance units news.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack firmed on Friday amid good buying interest after reports that the company planned to merge its infrastructure maintenance units, traders said.
By 1024 GMT the stock was at 389p, up 5-1/2p.
"We've seen strong buying interest," one trader said.
Analysts said Railtrack's reported plans to merge its maintenance units would help cut costs and consolidate its position.
"What we've seen for some time is that there is a lot of scope for tightening the reigns -- this is welcome news," one analyst said.
